issue.title: Trim full-help parser registrar imports
issue.description: Deferred by epic bead sase-en in plans:202608/bead_show_speed.md; not caused by that epic. Narrow command dispatch now avoids unrelated registrars, but full parser construction for bare/help/completion paths still imports every registrar through parser_full_registrars. Fresh imports on the integrated tree average 194.9 ms for sase.main.parser_vcs and 121.4 ms for sase.main.parser_ace. Scope: make parser registration dependencies lightweight or lazy for full-help and completion paths while preserving byte-identical help, parser registry parity, and all command choices.
